claims.evidence: Witness report does not show brand/model markings, screen size, or any powered-on display; only a large flat-screen with black bezel is described.

risks.risk: Screen may be faulty (no picture test shown); could have dead pixels, lines, backlight issues, or other display defects not visible while off/reflective
risks.proof: One clip of the TV powered on showing a test image (full-screen color bars) and a short video playback; include close-ups of any lines/dead pixels under normal brightness
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-tested/possibly faulty TV (worst case: display not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Unknown screen size and exact model; pricing depends heavily on inches and series
risks.proof: Photo of the label/branding on the back or side showing model number and screen size (or a clear shot of the bezel/model text)
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely tier for a large off-brand/unknown Samsung-like TV without confirming size/model.

risks.risk: Missing/uncertain accessories (remote, stand/legs, wall mount, power cable) can reduce value and increase buyer cost
risks.proof: Photo/video showing all included items laid out: remote, stand/legs or wall-mount bracket, power cable, and any manuals
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (no remote/stand assumed) until accessories are confirmed.

risks.risk: Ports/inputs may be damaged or non-functional (HDMI/USB/power), affecting usability
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports plus a quick connectivity test (plug in a HDMI device/USB and show it working)
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully functional for connectivity (worst case: ports may fail).

risks.risk: Audio/speaker issues not checked; could be silent, distorted, or with damaged speakers
risks.proof: Clip of the TV playing audio at normal volume with visible on-screen playback
risks.if_unproven: Price as audio unverified (worst case: speaker may be weak or faulty).

risks.risk: Physical condition unknown (scratches, cracks, panel damage) because only off/reflective view is reported
risks.proof: Multiple photos of the screen surface and bezel from different angles under bright light, plus a close-up of corners/edges
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially cosmetically imperfect (worst case: minor damage possible).

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the TV displaying properly (color bars + short playback) and confirming no lines/dead pixels
Clear photo of the back/side label with brand, exact model number, and screen size
Photos/video of included accessories: remote control, stand/legs or wall-mount bracket, power cable, and any manuals
Close-up photos of all ports (HDMI/USB/power) and a quick HDMI/USB connectivity test showing it works
Audio test clip (playback with sound) to confirm speakers are working
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a large flat-screen TV, but key value drivers (brand/model, exact size, and whether the display works) are not shown. Without a powered-on test and model/size verification, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
